title: Implement candidate handoff, validation, producer, and root workflows
description:
The immutable source freeze is authenticated into one candidate-tag event whose exact completion identity gates validation, all producers, and root assembly.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Protected workflows implement freeze-ID dispatch, annotated candidate-tag handoff, push-owned event completion, reusable normal/security/MSRV validation, native/source/MCP/OCI producers, and exact candidate-root assembly with least privilege.
- [hard] REQ-02: Every producer consumes the same authenticated event-completion and freeze identities; workflow fixtures reject source-ref overrides, movable identity, caller/checkout/OIDC mismatch, failed validation, missing producer evidence, or public-channel mutation.
- [hard] REQ-03: Candidate workflow YAML composes the fixed-ref authority and reusable producer interfaces without reimplementing either, and records overwrite-forbidden 90-day exact-ID transitions.

## Notes

Blast radius: candidate handoff, validation, producer-caller, and root workflow YAML plus focused contract fixtures.
